text_block_list.text:
Having defeated numerous rivals, Gold Ship 
secured her ticket to Eden. And waiting 
for her there was none other than 
Chairwoman Akikawa. Just as expected!

The secret tome was a plan concocted by 
Chairwoman Akikawa to motivate Gold Ship. 
And Eden is the utopia created by 
Umamusume—

It referred to the Twinkle Series. In 
other words, she had already reached Eden. 
However, Chairwoman Akikawa had nothing to 
do with the dream.

What was the voice in that dream? If Gold 
Ship keeps running along her golden 
journey, she might reach the answer 
someday.
